def form
    return @forced_form if !@forced_form.nil?
    return @form if $game_temp.in_battle || $game_temp.in_storage
    calc_form = MultipleForms.call("getForm", self)
    self.form = calc_form if calc_form && calc_form != @form
    return @form
  end

def form_simple
    return @forced_form || @form
  end

def level
    @level = growth_rate.level_from_exp(@exp) if !@level
    return @level
  end

def types
    return species_data.types.clone
  end

def gender
    if !@gender
      if species_data.single_gendered?
        case species_data.gender_ratio
        when :AlwaysMale   then @gender = 0
        when :AlwaysFemale then @gender = 1
        else                    @gender = 2
        end
      else
        female_chance = GameData::GenderRatio.get(species_data.gender_ratio).female_chance
        @gender = ((@personalID & 0xFF) < female_chance) ? 1 : 0
      end
    end
    return @gender
  end

def singleGendered?
    return species_data.single_gendered?
  end

def ability_index
    @ability_index = (@personalID & 1) if !@ability_index
    return @ability_index
  end

def ability_id
    if !@ability
      sp_data = species_data
      abil_index = ability_index
      if abil_index >= 2   # Hidden ability
        @ability = sp_data.hidden_abilities[abil_index - 2]
        abil_index = (@personalID & 1) if !@ability
      end
      if !@ability   # Natural ability or no hidden ability defined
        @ability = sp_data.abilities[abil_index] || sp_data.abilities[0]
      end
    end
    return @ability
  end

def hasHiddenAbility?
    return ability_index >= 2
  end

def getAbilityList
    ret = []
    sp_data = species_data
    sp_data.abilities.each_with_index { |a, i| ret.push([a, i]) if a }
    sp_data.hidden_abilities.each_with_index { |a, i| ret.push([a, i + 2]) if a }
    return ret
  end

def height
    return species_data.height
  end

def weight
    return species_data.weight
  end

def calcIV
    this_ivs = self.iv
    ret = {}
    GameData::Stat.each_main do |s|
      ret[s.id] = (@ivMaxed[s.id]) ? IV_STAT_LIMIT : this_ivs[s.id]
    end
    return ret
  end

def calcHP(base, level, iv, ev)
    return 1 if base == 1   # For Shedinja
    iv = ev = 0 if Settings::DISABLE_IVS_AND_EVS
    return (((base * 2) + iv + (ev / 4)) * level / 100).floor + level + 10
  end

def calcStat(base, level, iv, ev, nat)
    iv = ev = 0 if Settings::DISABLE_IVS_AND_EVS
    return (((((base * 2) + iv + (ev / 4)) * level / 100).floor + 5) * nat / 100).floor
  end

def getMoveList
    return species_data.moves
  end

def reset_moves
    this_level = self.level
    # Find all level-up moves that self could have learned
    moveset = self.getMoveList
    knowable_moves = []
    moveset.each { |m| knowable_moves.push(m[1]) if m[0] <= this_level }
    # Remove duplicates (retaining the latest copy of each move)
    knowable_moves = knowable_moves.reverse
    knowable_moves |= []
    knowable_moves = knowable_moves.reverse
    # Add all moves
    @moves.clear
    first_move_index = knowable_moves.length - MAX_MOVES
    first_move_index = 0 if first_move_index < 0
    (first_move_index...knowable_moves.length).each do |i|
      @moves.push(Pokemon::Move.new(knowable_moves[i]))
    end
  end

def clone
    ret = super
    ret.iv          = {}
    ret.ivMaxed     = {}
    ret.ev          = {}
    GameData::Stat.each_main do |s|
      ret.iv[s.id]      = @iv[s.id]
      ret.ivMaxed[s.id] = @ivMaxed[s.id]
      ret.ev[s.id]      = @ev[s.id]
    end
    ret.moves       = []
    @moves.each_with_index { |m, i| ret.moves[i] = m.clone }
    ret.first_moves = @first_moves.clone
    ret.owner       = @owner.clone
    ret.ribbons     = @ribbons.clone
    return ret
  end

def check_evolution_internal
    return nil if egg? || shadowPokemon?
    return nil if hasItem?(:EVERSTONE)
    return nil if hasAbility?(:BATTLEBOND)
    species_data.get_evolutions(true).each do |evo|   # [new_species, method, parameter, boolean]
      next if evo[3]   # Prevolution
      ret = yield self, evo[0], evo[1], evo[2]   # pkmn, new_species, method, parameter
      return ret if ret
    end
    return nil
  end

def check_evolution_on_level_up
    return check_evolution_internal do |pkmn, new_species, method, parameter|
      success = GameData::Evolution.get(method).call_level_up(pkmn, parameter)
      next (success) ? new_species : nil
    end
  end

def self.get_species_form(species, form)
      return nil if !species || !form
      validate species => [Symbol, self, String]
      validate form => Integer
      species = species.species if species.is_a?(self)
      species = species.to_sym if species.is_a?(String)
      trial = sprintf("%s_%d", species, form).to_sym
      species_form = (DATA[trial].nil?) ? species : trial
      return (DATA.has_key?(species_form)) ? DATA[species_form] : nil
    end

def default_form
      @flags.each do |flag|
        return $~[1].to_i if flag[/^DefaultForm_(\d+)$/i]
      end
      return -1
    end

def base_form
      default = default_form
      return (default >= 0) ? default : @form
    end

def base_stat_total
      return @base_stats.values.sum
    end

def single_gendered?
      return GameData::GenderRatio.get(@gender_ratio).single_gendered?
    end

def get_evolutions(exclude_invalid = false)
      ret = []
      @evolutions.each do |evo|
        next if evo[3]   # Is the prevolution
        next if evo[1] == :None && exclude_invalid
        ret.push([evo[0], evo[1], evo[2]])   # [Species, method, parameter]
      end
      return ret
    end

def get_family_evolutions(exclude_invalid = true)
      evos = get_evolutions(exclude_invalid)
      evos = evos.sort { |a, b| GameData::Species.keys.index(a[0]) <=> GameData::Species.keys.index(b[0]) }
      ret = []
      evos.each do |evo|
        ret.push([@species].concat(evo))   # [Prevo species, evo species, method, parameter]
        evo_array = GameData::Species.get(evo[0]).get_family_evolutions(exclude_invalid)
        ret.concat(evo_array) if evo_array && evo_array.length > 0
      end
      return ret
    end

def get_previous_species
      return @species if @evolutions.length == 0
      @evolutions.each { |evo| return evo[0] if evo[3] }   # Is the prevolution
      return @species
    end

def get_baby_species(check_items = false, item1 = nil, item2 = nil)
      ret = @species
      return ret if @evolutions.length == 0
      @evolutions.each do |evo|
        next if !evo[3]   # Check only the prevolution
        if check_items
          incense = GameData::Species.get(evo[0]).incense
          ret = evo[0] if !incense || item1 == incense || item2 == incense
        else
          ret = evo[0]   # Species of prevolution
        end
        break
      end
      ret = GameData::Species.get(ret).get_baby_species(check_items, item1, item2) if ret != @species
      return ret
    end

def minimum_level
      return 1 if @evolutions.length == 0
      @evolutions.each do |evo|
        next if !evo[3]   # Check only the prevolution
        prevo_data = GameData::Species.get_species_form(evo[0], base_form)
        return 1 if !prevo_data.incense.nil?
        prevo_min_level = prevo_data.minimum_level
        evo_method_data = GameData::Evolution.get(evo[1])
        return prevo_min_level if evo_method_data.level_up_proc.nil? && evo_method_data.id != :Shedinja
        any_level_up = evo_method_data.any_level_up
        return (any_level_up) ? prevo_min_level + 1 : evo[2]
      end
      return 1
    end

def total_pp
      max_pp = GameData::Move.get(@id).total_pp
      return max_pp + (max_pp * @ppup / 5)
    end

def self.hasFunction?(pkmn, func)
    spec = (pkmn.is_a?(Pokemon)) ? pkmn.species : pkmn
    sp = @@formSpecies[spec]
    return sp && sp[func]
  end

def self.getFunction(pkmn, func)
    spec = (pkmn.is_a?(Pokemon)) ? pkmn.species : pkmn
    sp = @@formSpecies[spec]
    return (sp && sp[func]) ? sp[func] : nil
  end

complete_facts.label: CONSTRUCTOR_ORDER
complete_meanings: Species.get先严格解析，存储base species与base_form，forced/time nil；level=先写该成长曲线最低经验与level，此时没有现成派生字段保证。
然后初始化非蛋步数0/状态、空gender/shiny/ability_index/ability/nature/override与item/mail；withMoves真时reset_moves早于IV、Owner及PID随机。
每主能力独立rand(IV_STAT_LIMIT+1)入iv，ev零，ivMaxed初空；Owner参数为Owner则直接共享同对象，为Player/NPCTrainer则复制训练师信息到新Owner，其它取0/空名/2/2默认。
获得方式可因Fateful开关置4，map缺时0、obtain_level保存传入level、Time.now时间戳，然后PID两次rand16bit合并；hp/totalhp先1，再calc_stats。
仅存储form==0且recheck_form真才调用getFormOnCreation；返回值按Ruby truthy处理（0也进入），form=完整提交之后withMoves真才再次reset_moves。返回nil/false不进入，withMoves假不重建招。
constructor自身不一般入队、消费球或标记owned；创建形态hook中form=的条件Dex登记可在constructor返回前发生。此前随机/Owner/EXP等写入不因后继失败自动撤销。

form getter先对forced非nil直接返回（false也直接返），否则战斗/储存守卫返回stored；再getForm callback，truthy且不同stored才form=。两getter对false的语义不同。

complete_facts.label: ABILITY_LIST_AND_RESOLUTION
complete_meanings: ability_index仅nil/false时填PID&1，写索引不校范围但清ability值；hasHiddenAbility?仅index>=2，不等于实际解析出隐藏身份。
ability_id在ability值缺时读当前species_data；index>=2先hidden[index-2]，缺时改局部索引为PID&1；自然分支abilities[index] || abilities[0]，不把第三自然索引2按相同规则当第三普通能力解析。
getAbilityList逐全部truthy自然身份列[id,i]，再全部隐藏[id,i+2]，不去重、不截两自然。因此可能同索引2同时对应第三自然与首隐藏。
ability=允许nil/false清值，truthy未知身份早返而不写；合法直接指定能力值不改index。species=/form=只清值，后继读可按旧index与新Species重新解析。

complete_facts.label: STATS_EV_IV_HP
complete_meanings: baseStats复制主能力键值到新hash；Species.base_stat_total对当前base_stats全部values求和，不读取个体有效IV/EV/性格或场上阶级。
calcIV取存储IV并按各ivMaxed true用IV_STAT_LIMIT；禁用IV/EV配置作用于计算，不规范化存储，直接EV255仍255。
calcHP特例B==1返回1，其余按2B+IV+EV/4先整数运算、乘等级/100再+level+10；calcStat先同样整除后+5再乘nature/100整除。
calc_stats读current baseStats/level/calcIV/nature_for_stats，按Stat.each_main算六项；先更新totalhp，再当旧hp>0或HP增量>0时hp=至少1的旧hp+增量，否则原hp0保留。
hp写穿自身状态是个体定义，设施/战斗是否额外保持濒死由caller负责；重算不自动删除超额EV/补总EV余数。

complete_meanings: Pokemon.height/weight原样返回当前species_data字段，单位分别dm/hg；未在这两方法加入战斗LIGHTMETAL/HEAVYMETAL/Autotomize/FloatStone等修正。
Species.initialize对types/abilities/hidden/evolutions/base_stats等hash/array值直接接引用；主能力base_stats<=0补1、evs<0补0会改传入hash，不承诺深拷贝。
同初始化高度/重量省略或nil/false经||取1；显式0 truthy保留0。default_form按首个匹配DefaultForm数字旗标（字面正则）取整数，base_form优先该>=0值否则record form。

complete_facts.label: EVOLUTION_GETTERS
complete_meanings: get_evolutions始终过滤prevo，exclude_invalid真时额外过滤None，结果为新三元组列表保持原前向顺序；不是回传所有原reverse数组。
get_family_evolutions按Species.keys目标登记序排序后递归拼[prevo,target,method,param]；get_previous_species取首reverse，否则自身。
get_baby_species首reverse及可选incense门后递归；minimum_level首选reverse的prevo.incense非nil→1，其它按prevo最小/level_up_proc/Shedinja/any_level_up规则，详完整方法。
check_evolution_internal是实际个体门：egg/Shadow、Everstone、BattleBond前置，然后currentSpecies有序非None条目首个truthy；minimum_level不是这个检查门。
只对合法无环关系承诺这些递归用途，未知enum作者阶段拒与裸坏method运行属于不同入口；未执行真实compiled/Marshal reload。
